heading_path: 22.11  Amendments made by the Trade Marks Amendment (Fees) Regulation 2016
text: The amendments of Schedule 9 made by items 2 and 3 of the Trade Marks Amendment (Fees) Regulation 2016 apply in relation to an AFS request that is submitted on or after the commencement of those items.
